text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, a fan exchange event hosted by the Academy was being held.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I love seeing Ayabe-san run!
Shooting past the pack just like a falling star...

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you like that gave me so much courage...
and I've wanted to tell you that for the longest time!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
I'll continue to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: And the Trainer supporting that kind of running! Your seamless coordination is always so incredible to see!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: I'm expecting great things from the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her words were heartwarming... Yet contrary to them, her expression only grew stiffer and stiffer...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Not bad.
...Next person, here they come.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Such was the girl she was, but—

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: I used to watch your mother's races too! I'm really looking forward to seeing your family's continued success!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
…………
Yes, please keep cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
"Please make sure you win your next race!
I'm rooting for you!!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her response remained the same as always,
but her expression was undeniably growing stiffer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That evening.
Admire Vega was nowhere to be found, and as I searched
around worriedly—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is that solo training? 
She seems to be running pretty hard.
...The reason for that is probably—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: Not a fan of events like today's?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …………Not really.
choice_data_list: If you don't like it, I could cut down on the amount or something—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't do anything unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If anything... I need to listen to their voices
even more... I must.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Those cheers... they were never meant for me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It wasn't meant for me... It was something that child should have received and been praised for...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's why...
I absolutely have to deliver...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's my—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A mission since the day I was born.
...The one and only thing I can do.
choice_data_list: I'll do my best alongside you, doing whatever I can.
I'll do what I can and work hard together with you!
I don't think it's the only one.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A mission since the day I was born.
...The one and only thing I can do.
choice_data_list: I'll do my best alongside you, doing whatever I can.
I'll do what I can and work hard together with you!
I don't think it's the only one.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's just—

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: I'm expecting great things from the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...'Live up to expectations,' huh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well... in moderation, okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Other than that...
what else can I even do...?"

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you like that gave me so much courage...
and I've wanted to tell you that for the longest time!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......I suppose so.
